name: Catch The Wave Swim School
line: Every Heater On Its Own Dimmer
lede: At a swim school in South Beloit, a 40 by 20 ft covered patio is warmed by Bromic Tungsten Electric heaters placed to a Bromic layout. Each has its own dimmer, so staff can match the warmth to the day.
beats: A covered patio of 40 by 20 ft at a swim school.
Families and staff needed the patio comfortable in cooler weather, with heat that could be set to the day.
Tungsten Electric heaters were placed at the locations and heights set by a Bromic layout, checked on site. Each heater has its own dimmer, from 0 to 100% output.
team: Recommendation and site assessment: Gunn & Pegelow
